title: Toy triangular-number deduction (proof drafts, not certified proofs)

claims.statement: For every integer n >= 0, twice the sum of the integers from 1 through n equals n*(n+1); the empty sum is zero.
assumptions: n is an integer and n >= 0.

evidence.description: Induction argument and the first-ten deduction; an unreviewed proof draft.
Exact finite check for n=0..1000; this is supplementary evidence, not a universal proof.

verification.scope: Draft argument supplied with reproducible finite regression test; no independent review or formal proof checker is claimed.
trust: Ordinary integer arithmetic and mathematical induction; Python integer arithmetic for the finite test.
